job.email_subject: Application: Product Owner Digital Customer Solutions – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need a Product Owner who turns customer needs into digital solutions that really work with the systems behind them – that is my 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with business teams
– OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third parties
– Extensive use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, development and documentation

Because I come from development, I discuss feasibility with engineers on equal terms and keep the backlog realistic. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Product Owner Digital Customer Solutions | Techno-Functional, B2B E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional product professional with 5+ years shaping digital customer solutions on enterprise B2B commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Translates customer and business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications, prioritizes with stakeholders and works closely with development teams in Scrum and PI Planning. Strong understanding of APIs, headless and PWA frontends, product data and ERP integration. Uses generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Hörmann is a European leader in doors and gates, and digital customer solutions are becoming a key part of how dealers and customers work with you. My experience with B2B digital commerce at Rockwell Automation, another industrial manufacturer, lets me shape solutions that fit both customer needs and your systems.

en.subject: Application: Product Owner Digital Customer Solutions
en.hook: Digital customer solutions for an industrial manufacturer only work when customer needs, product data and back-end systems fit together. That is my background: for more than five years I have turned business requirements into digital B2B solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, working hand in hand with stakeholders and development teams.

bullets.label: User stories & backlog
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Digital B2B customer solutions
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: APIs & connected systems
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP web services and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters.

bullets.label: Efficient product work with AI
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation in day-to-day delivery.

en.logistics: Because I come from development, I discuss feasibility with engineers on equal terms and keep the backlog realistic. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
